title: Navigate with onboard GPS only on an open map
summary: The robot runs as a self-contained autonomous package that navigates with onboard GPS only. The operator draws the region and exclusions on an open map, a dual-antenna receiver supplies heading, and the route margin includes the GPS error bound. No UAV, SLAM or ground map supports navigation; Stage 3 terrain walking relies on body sensing.
next: Choose RTK or plain GPS and freeze the GPS error bound, heading source and outage timeout in issue #20.
